extracted.intended_audience: literate general public interested in politics and contemporary debates about constitutional government (readers of political pamphlets and commentary)
extracted.subtask_description: A late-18th-century political pamphlet/essay arguing in favor of the French Revolution and critiquing English constitutional practice and Burke's positions; intended as persuasive public political commentary and historical narrative. The text traces causes of the Revolution and contrasts French and English institutions and manners.
